concerns.text: Task T010 (Monte Carlo Power Simulation) depends on T035 (Holm-Bonferroni correction) and T009 (Synthetic Data). However, T035 is located in Phase 5 (US3), while T010 is in Phase 2 (Foundational). This creates a circular dependency where a foundational task depends on a user-story task that hasn't been implemented yet. T010 must be moved to Phase 5 or T035 must be moved to Phase 2.

Task T019.1 (Pre-study pilot check) depends on T011.1, T011.3, and T014.1. T011.1 (Static bundle generator) depends on T011.2 (Download OSF). T011.2 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but implies a network fetch that must complete before T011.1 can run. While T011.2 is listed in Phase 2, the dependency chain T011.2 -> T011.1 -> T014.1 -> T019.1 is valid, but T011.3 (Local Server) and T011.4 (Host Pilot) are also in Phase 2. The critical issue is T014.1 (Web interface wrapper) depends on T011.1 and T011.3, but T014.1 is in Phase 3 (US1). This splits the 'Web Interface' artifact flow across Phase 2 and Phase 3, violating the 'Foundational tasks first' principle for the web interface component required by FR-002.

Task T038 (Sensitivity analysis report) depends on T038.1 (Objective screen-time ingestion). However, T038.1 is listed AFTER T038 in the task list, despite T038 explicitly stating 'Depends on T038.1'. The ordering violates the producer-consumer rule: the consumer (T038) appears before the producer (T038.1).

Task T040 (Final report generator) depends on T010 (Power simulation), T037 (Statistical summary), and T041 (Validation status). T010 is in Phase 2, T037 is in Phase 5, but T041 is not defined in the task list. The dependency on an undefined task (T041) breaks the artifact flow for the final report.

Task T009 and T013 are duplicates (both 'Create synthetic data generator for baseline validation'). T009 is in Phase 2, T013 is in Phase 3. This duplication creates ambiguity in the artifact flow: which task actually generates the data consumed by T014, T015, T016? The order implies T013 (Phase 3) might be the intended generator, but T009 (Phase 2) is listed first. This needs consolidation to ensure a single source of truth for the synthetic data artifact.
